original_request: Ecommerce field la enaku unsolved problems kudu
objective: Discover potentially unsolved operational frictions and workarounds in ecommerce logistics and reconciliation

research_streams.name: Marketplace Settlement & Payout Reconciliation
research_questions: What manual methods do online sellers use to cross-verify marketplace settlement reports against bank payouts?
Where do deductions and chargeback discrepancies get identified in weekly bookkeeping?

hypotheses.claim: Sellers lose untracked margin due to opaque marketplace deduction codes in CSV settlements.

research_streams.name: Warehouse Packing & Courier Handoff Discrepancies
research_questions: How are parcels verified when handed over from merchant warehouse to 3PL couriers?
What physical dispute records are kept when courier scans fail at intake?

hypotheses.claim: Warehouse workers maintain paper manifest registers to contest courier lost-in-transit claims.

assumptions: Sellers utilize multi-channel marketplaces rather than single proprietary storefronts.
unknowns: Target geography (unspecified by user; carried forward as unknown)
Volume tier of sellers being investigated
Observable monetary value of reconciliation loss
